mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days as investors shift toward risk assets.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.2% in 80% of instances but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases (t-test p > 0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 600 thousand units signals robust consumer demand for residential construction, triggering positive equity returns as housing activity correlates with broader economic expansion and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: HOUST > 600 in 80% of instances but 20-day forward returns are negative in > 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in payrolls (PAYEMS) and declining unemployment (UNRATE) indicates strengthening labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate profitability, producing positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE decline > 0.2pp but 20-day returns negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 95 index points indicates contraction in manufacturing output, triggering negative equity returns as supply-side weakness correlates with declining corporate margins and recessionary risk.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95 in 80% of instances but 60-day returns positive in > 60% of cases (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 218.5 index points signals accelerating price pressures that prompt central bank rate hikes, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 218.5 in 80% of instances but 5-day returns positive in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Retail sales growth above 367,000 million dollars indicates strong consumer spending momentum, driving positive equity returns as revenue growth supports corporate earnings expansion over 20 days.
failure_condition: RSAFS > 367,000 in 80% of instances but 20-day returns negative in > 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate above 9.5% during post-recession recovery phases signals labor market slack that precedes wage growth and consumption acceleration, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 9.5% in 80% of instances but 60-day returns negative in > 60% of cases (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 95) and slowing GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% quarterly) indicates weakening supply capacity, triggering negative equity returns as output contraction reduces corporate revenue potential.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 95 and GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% but 60-day returns positive in > 60% of cases.
